why_agent_cannot: identity verification is required and cannot be performed by an agent
what_human_must_do: Open tranches.reflect.money from reflect.money or the docs. A box asks you to accept the terms and confirm you understand the risks before you continue.
Connect a Solana wallet. No sign-up or KYC is mentioned for this app.

Pick a market, then choose Protected or Amplified and deposit the market's asset. Warning Amplified takes losses first and can lose everything. Protected positions can be redeemed at any time, but Amplified ones wait out a cooldown first: "Junior positions have a cooldown".
Check your points, level and rank with the Points button or on the leaderboard.

Only use reflect.money and its subdomains. Reflect says: "We do not operate an official Discord, Telegram, Bluesky, LinkedIn, or any other platform not listed here." Tokens called Reflect, RFL or RFI on other chains aren't Reflect's.
costs: Points come only from money you deposit, so the airdrop hunt isn't free. You pay Solana fees: "Network fees (e.g., Solana transaction/compute fees, priority fees) and permissionless crank costs are paid by Users as part of normal operation." Reflect can also charge protocol-level fees, which it hasn't set out. Markets have deposit caps that can fill up.
risks: "You are at least 18 years old and have the capacity to form a binding contract." No list of excluded countries is published; the terms bar "Restricted Jurisdictions" and sanctioned users, and Reflect may geo-block.
